items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know Zilner Randolph? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, Z.T.

ctx.x: And this is where Basie got that thing, from "One O'Clock Jump." But he used to call that Old Babe, you know what I mean? And that was just a riff, you know?
